'''Són Halliikeenovich'''<ref name="DaG">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="CSWE" /> with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and light skin. He<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from [[House Halliikeenovich]],<ref name="TEA" /> a lesser [[Noble/Legends|noble]] house<ref name="SWC">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> perceived as greedy and grasping which originated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dramassia]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]].<ref name="SWC" /> During the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Halliikeenovich regularly patronized the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]],<ref name="CSWE" /> located within the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] on<ref name="SWC" /> the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SWC" /> Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], Halliikeenovich attempted to court [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Terr Taneel/Legends|Terr Taneel]]<ref name="SWC" /> of [[House Taneel]], who represented the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="CSWE Taneel">{{CSWECite|III|216|Taneel, Terr}}</ref> Halliikeenovich sought to strengthen both their houses<ref name="SWC" /> and establish a stronger connection with the houses of the Senex sector.<ref name="CSWE" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Halliikeenovich attended<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> a performance of the ballet [[Squid Lake/Legends|''Squid Lake'']]<ref name="ROTS IS">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> at the Galaxies [[Opera/Legends|Opera]] House, wearing a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]] with a white undershirt, brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]], and black [[Hat/Legends|hat]]. He spoke to Taneel outside of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Palpatine's private viewing box|private viewing box]] when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] rushed past their conversation to meet with Palpatine.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Són Halliikeenovich first appeared, albeit unnamed, in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the third and final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]]<ref name="ROTS" /> released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The character remained unnamed until the release of ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''<ref name="DaG" /> on [[October 11]] of that year<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archivedate=20260701041521}}</ref> which provided the character's name in an index of costumes.<ref name="DaG" /> Són Halliikeenovich is a [[tuckerization]] of [[Jason Hallikainen]], who played the character<ref name="Family Affair">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-a-family-affair|text=''Star Wars'', A Family Affair|nolive=1}}</ref> in the Opera House corridor scene which was shot entirely on blue-screen.<ref name="SkywalkerSage">''[[Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' &mdash; [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]: "ILM Episode III Siggraph Reel"</ref> Hallikainen is the husband of [[Amanda Lucas]], who portrayed Terr Taneel in the same scene as Halliikeenovich's sole appearance.<ref name="Family Affair" />
